name: ctx
title: Ctx
description: Build a bounded, budgeted **context pack** from existing symbols. Resolves `include` (minus `exclude`) to its members, then — when `budget` is set — shrinks the pack *at evaluation* by visibility tier then declared order until within the char budget, recording any dropped members in the run trace. Produces a `Ctx` value bound to `name`. Pure: it selects and labels existing values, performing no IO (the load-bearing elevation of PRD §13 explicit context management).
